subject: BLOCKING immutable sampler v2: Vulkan enums copied as Metal enums
body: New render v2 sampler bug in tegu_generic_v2_sampler: GenericBinding immutable fields are VULKAN enums, as air_bridge.rs1734..1736 exports desc.*.as_raw(), and old tegu_generic_immutable_sampler explicitly uses Vk wrap map. n2t_sampler_state expects METAL enums. Direct assignment changes semantics: VulkanREPEAT0 becomes MetalCLAMP_EDGE0; VulkanCLAMP_EDGE2 becomes MetalREPEAT2; Vulkan mipLINEAR1 becomes Metal mipNEAREST1. Map addresses Vk0/1/2/3/4 -> N2T2/3/0/5/1, mipVk0/1 -> N2T1/2 (NOT_MIPMAPPED requires actual plan clamp/state, cannot infer). BorderVk0/2/4 float transparent/black/white -> N2T0/1/2; integerVk1/3/5 need correct per-use integer border or precise refusal. The v1 immutable path already loses mip/border, so v2 must not carry that loss forward. GenericBinding also omits immutable min/maxLOD, normalized, bias and relevant per-use properties; obtain exact desc fields via additive Rust sidecar, or refuse affected classes until representable. Test each enum with distinct nondefault values against Mesa oracle, especially repeat+linearMip+opaqueWhite. Do not call these fields Metal enums in documentation.
